<!-- Check docs/PRODUCT_SPEC.md and docs/ROADMAP.md first. The bootstrap exists;
logging and recovery capabilities remain planned. Distinguish them from implemented behaviour. -->

## Administrator or contributor problem

Who needs this, and what task cannot be done safely or effectively with the current scope?

## Proposed behaviour

Give a concrete workflow or example. Distinguish logging, inspection and restoration if the proposal involves a new event/state type.

## Scope and alternatives

What is the smallest useful version? Which existing roadmap requirement does this extend? Describe alternatives and what can remain out of scope.

## Correctness and operational considerations

Where relevant, consider cancellation, attribution, snapshot completeness, item conservation, overload, partial failure, compatibility and permissions. Unknowns are welcome; do not invent guarantees or performance figures.

## Completion evidence

What observable result and tests would establish that the feature works? Include primary API references or a reproducible experiment if available.
